map.会议时间冲突检测工具，添加多个日程时间段自动检测重叠并可视化时间轴，帮助行政人员: A meeting time conflict detection tool that adds multiple schedule intervals, detects overlaps automatically and visualizes them on a timeline, helping administrators plan schedules and avoid clashes.
map.把多名同事的日程（名称、时间）汇总后检测撞车，提前发出冲突预警，便于改期或委派他: Aggregate several colleagues' schedules (name, time) and detect clashes to warn early, making rescheduling or delegation easy.
map.同一会议室被多场会议申请时，用工具核对时间轴，标出资源争用时段并分配优先级。: When several meetings request the same room, use the tool to check the timeline, mark resource contention intervals and assign priorities.
map.混合'现场 + 远程'排期时，检测同一主持人的线下会与线上会是否重叠，避免分身。: When mixing "onsite + remote" scheduling, check whether the same host's offline and online meetings overlap to avoid double booking.
map.同一主持人的两场日程撞车: Two agenda slots of the same host clash
map.：录入日程：需求评审 周三 14:00-15:00、迭代规划 周三 14:30-: : enter the schedule: requirements review Wednesday 14:00-15:00, iteration planning Wednesday 14:30-15:30, standup Thursday 09:30-09:45. The tool finds that requirements review and iteration planning overlap during 14:30-15:00, warns that the same host cannot attend both, and suggests delaying iteration planning by 30 minutes or staggering it.
map.和'会议时间冲突检测'有什么区别？: How does it differ from "meeting time conflict detection"?
map.两者都做时间区间重叠判定，侧重点不同：本工具偏向'日程/人员'维度的撞车预警与改: Both check time-interval overlap but with different emphasis: this tool focuses on "schedule/personnel" clash warnings and rescheduling suggestions, while the other focuses on "arrangement by date" for meeting rooms and time slots. Use either per habit; the conclusions agree.
map.检测出冲突后怎么处理？: What to do after a conflict is detected?
map.优先调整低优先级会议时间，或变更主持人/ venue；若必须并行，拆分会场或改为: First try shifting low-priority meeting times or changing the host/venue; if parallel sessions are unavoidable, split the room or switch to asynchronous review. The tool only lists conflicts and suggestions, and the final schedule follows the meeting organizer's confirmation.
